## Deployment Strategy

**Default: Local Deployment**
- All code changes are deployed locally first
- Testing and verification happen on localhost
- Only deploy to production/online when explicitly requested
- Verify all online code is synced locally before making changes

**When to Deploy Online:**
- Only on explicit user request ("deploy to production", "deploy online", etc.)
- Never auto-deploy without confirmation
- Always confirm the deployment target before proceeding

**Workflow:**
1. Make changes locally
2. Test locally
3. Commit to git
4. Wait for explicit deployment request
5. Verify before pushing to remote/production
